purpose: Single stable entrypoint for fresh chats and coding agents. Route first; do not reconstruct the whole repository before knowing the task.
routing_algorithm: Match the human request to one active workstream.
Read that workstream PACK and LAST_RETURN before material work.
Read only the global deltas newer than the pack watermark that intersect the pack topics.
Expand into authority/source files only when the pack points there or evidence requires it.
Work in the pack mode: LAB, INTEGRATE or RELEASE.
At a meaningful boundary, emit the compact RETURN contract; promote only genuinely cross-workstream discoveries to the global delta feed.

special_triggers.PROMETEO: Use this entrypoint, then route the user's current intent.
special_triggers.PROMETEO PATENT: Resolve the Patent task first, while authority still comes from repository Reincarnation.
Continue the already-routed workstream from its PACK/LAST_RETURN. Do not restart planning unless source drift invalidates it.

truth: This control plane coordinates work. It is not Current, Human Accepted, Served, or product authority.
